reuse.why: Extends the tree's single applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend definition with a holidays parameter and expresses daily skipping through RSchedule exdates next to recurConfigToRSchedule, which already encodes the daily weekend skip.

duplication.why: The off-day predicate exists once; the only repetition is wiring recurConfigToExdates into each RSchedule construction (three sites).

placement.why: Both rules sit in shared/schedules.ts beside the existing weekend rule and the rrule builder; callers only pass config fields.

scope.why: Focused on the feature; the getDatesInRange lookaround is widened from 3 to an arbitrary 14 days.

maintainability.why: Clear single definitions, though the daily-skip rule is split between byDayOfWeek in recurConfigToRSchedule and a separate exdates helper every RSchedule constructor must remember to pass.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All moves go through applyWeekendRule; daily exclusion through recurConfigToExdates.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the repeated exdates argument is wiring, not a copied rule.

one_place.where: Moving rule in getDateWithSkippedWeekend (via applyWeekendRule) and daily skip in recurConfigToExdates, both in shared/schedules.ts and used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, parseRecurDate and schedule-template; callers must still wire exdates individually.
